description: This file defines the MACAddress class within the Thunder::Core namespace, providing functionality for handling MAC addresses including parsing, comparison, validation, and string conversion.

classes.name: MACAddress
classes.description: A class representing a MAC address with methods for parsing, comparison, validation, and string conversion.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two MACAddress instances are equal by comparing their internal byte arrays.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two MACAddress instances are not equal.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the MAC address to a human-readable string in hexadecimal format separated by colons.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes the input string to determine its format (hex, delimited hex, base64) for conversion.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts the input string to a byte array based on the detected format.
